approach.description: the chosen architecture in 3-6 sentences: what is built, in what shape, and why this shape over the obvious alternatives

rejectedAlternatives.description: each considered-and-rejected shape with its one-line trade-off

buildSteps.description: ordered build steps; each names the exact files touched and near-code for anything non-obvious

risks.description: what could sink this plan: contract breaks, races, RLS, migration hazards

openQuestions.description: decisions the brief leaves genuinely open; empty when none
